name: verifyInsuranceEligibility
shortDescription: Verifies a patient's insurance eligibility with an external insurance platform.
description:
Overview

Checks a patient's insurance eligibility and coverage details with an external insurance provider platform.

Intended use

Called by the patient-facing UI during registration or appointment scheduling, or by an admin for billing purposes. It requires patient identification and insurance details.

Logic

  1. Retrieve Patient details (e.g., firstName, lastName, dateOfBirth) and insurance information from params.
  2. Connect to the InsurancePlatform external service using ctx.service('InsurancePlatform').
  3. Send a request to the insurance platform's API to verify eligibility based on the collected patient and insurance data.
  4. Parse the response from the external service to determine eligibility status and coverage details.
  5. Return the eligibility status and any relevant details (e.g., co-pay, deductible).
  6. Audit-log the insurance verification attempt and its outcome using ctx.audit.log.

Entities

  • Patient

External Services

  • InsurancePlatform
